_comment: Chu Chü Beauty brand library. SAME shape as shades.json (tone -> step -> product), which is what mergeBrandLibrary() in app.js expects. Loading this file attaches these entries to the EXISTING recommendation for the same tone as additional candidates (.alt); nothing in shades.json or foundations.json is replaced. bestProduct() scores every candidate against the analysed skin tone and the selected look and displays ONE winner. Every entry here is a real, currently listed Chu Chü product, and every hex was sampled (median pixel) from Chu Chü's official Multiuse Heart Paint shade guide. Heart Paint is sold as a multi-use cheek, lip and lid colour, so it is valid in the lips step. Within each tone, one candidate sits closer to the skin than the primary entry (wins on School / Professional) and one sits further (wins on Date / Party), except dark_warm, where no Heart Paint shade is closer than the primary. Eyebrows, contour and foundation are intentionally omitted until official Chu Chü swatches are available; the primary entries from shades.json and foundations.json still cover those steps.
